KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Name: Commander Zilyana
KeysToEntries.Quest.Name: Regicide
KeysToEntries.DragonGate.NotDoneDragonSlayer.Genderles: The blood of the four seal this gate. One of earth, one of water, one of air and one of flame.
The lord of the skies has fallen. Xikotal, slain by Kuldra's fury.
KeysToEntries.DragonGate.DragonSlayerComplete.Genderle: The scaled blight has been slain. Velgar's cruelty no longer infects the earth.
KeysToEntries.DragonGate.FellHollowComplete.Genderless: Gentle Imaru, blessed by water, finally rests in peace.
KeysToEntries.DragonGate.UmbralSandsComplete.Genderles: The gate stands open, destiny awaits.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.Intro.1: Ah, good you're here. Your allies have already filled me in on your exploits, and I must say I'm impressed.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.Intro.2: Not many people could stand up to the dragons of Kuldra's brood, let alone survive in a place like this, yet you almost make it look easy.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.Intro.3: Which is why I need you to finish this threat, once and for all. Kuldra's threatening all of Gielinor now. Shockwaves of discordant anima have been blasting out from this place and they're getting stronger with each wave.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.Intro.4: My lord, Saradomin, has called me here to help deal with the threat, but the anima here... it's like it drains me, I feel myself weakening the closer I get to her tower. So I'm afraid I have to pass the torch to you.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.Intro.5: This island will make a vital base, take some time to set yourself up for success. There will be no raids or anything here, I'll see to that.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.INeedMoreTimeResponse.1: It's wise to plan and prepare, but don't take too long. Kuldra's readying herself to unleash a catastrophe across Gielinor that could see the end of everything.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.INeedMoreTimeResponse.2: We should put a stop to that, as soon as possible.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.ImReadyResponse.1: Good. I will take you to Kuldra's island. I'll aid you where I can, and I'll extract you if you require it, but the bulk of the battle will fall to you.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.ImReadyResponse.2: May Saradomin guide and watch over you! And may Kuldra know his wrath! TO BATTLE!
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.SpokenTo.NotStartedRun.1: When you're ready, I will take you as far to Kuldra's lair as I can. You'll need to fight your way to the centre of her stronghold yourself.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.SpokenTo.NotStartedRun.2: Be sure you're as prepared as you can be. Are you ready to kill the queen?
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.SpokenTo.AttemptedRun.1: You made good progress. I have faith that you can see this through. Are you ready to try again?
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.SpokenTo.CompletedFirstRun.1: Saradomin was right to put his faith in you, just as we all were. You have slain the God Eater and saved all of Gielinor in the process.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.SpokenTo.CompletedFirstRun.2: Alas, there will be no statues in your honour on the mainland. Nor will bards sing songs of your deeds, for Guthix's veil will prevent your legend escaping these isles for now.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.SpokenTo.CompletedFirstRun.3: But the people here will remember the good you have done, and in time we will find a way to let the world know of your heroism.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.SpokenTo.CompletedFirstRun.4: Here, let me take that vile trophy from you, so that I might reward you with something more fitting your stature than this... slimy mess.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.AttemptToReceiveReward.No: Ah, but your burden is too great right now. Come speak to me when you have divested yourself of some of what you carry.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.HandedOverHead.1: Here, it is a mere trifle compared to the gift you have given the rest of us with Kuldra's death, yet I hope it will serve you well.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.DontHandOverHead.1: It is a grim tradition to carry the body parts of your slain enemy, but as a warrior I understand it. When you are ready to move on, come speak to me again.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.DefeatedKuldra.RepeatFigh: Ah, looking to relive your moment of glory? Come with me down memory lane to face Kuldra again?
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.DefeatedKuldra.ReturnWith: Dragons, they seem to have so many heads, don't they? Let me take that one from you.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.CheckPointQuery: Where would you like me to take you?
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.OptionalDialogue.Intro.1: What would you like to know?
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.GenderlessVoice.OptionalDia: What can you tell me about Saradomin?
What can you tell me about Kuldra?
What can you tell me about the dragonkin?
I've asked everything I need to.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.OptionalDialogue.AboutSel: My name is Commander Zilyana, and I allow myself the personal pride to call myself the right hand of Saradomin.
For centuries I have served as the leader of his armies and herald of his divine wisdom.
I am of the icyene, a race of proud, winged warriors, from the world of Hallow. The seat of Saradomin's power.
Until comparatively recently I had been frozen in time, trapped in the God Wars even though the world had moved on.
Well... I say moved on, I sometimes wonder whether times ever really change.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.OptionalDialogue.Saradomi: My lord Saradomin is the one true god. While others may profess to possess divine power, they lack the wisdom and the foresight that true divinity requires.

Bandos wielded his power like a club. Zamorak uses his to form pacts with demonic creatures seeking to spread corruption and dismay. While Armadyl cowers from his, unwilling to fully shoulder  the burden of godhood.
Saradomin improves the lives of his followers. Through his wisdom he has turned civilisations away from tribal warfare and helped them to become thriving nations.
As one of the oldest of the gods, his wisdom is honed across the aeons of discoveries,  unexpected crises and patient reflection.
His guidance helps us all to find our place in the world. That thing which each of us craves from the day of our birth, a need to belong and be useful.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.OptionalDialogue.Kuldra.1: She has consumed more of the world's raw anima than anyone should be able to, and she has been forged with the blood of the garou's fallen deity.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.OptionalDialogue.Kuldra.2: Her power rivals just about anything on this planet, myself included. Were the gods still here, I'm sure they could deal with her, but sadly the so-called "World Guardian" foolishly put a stop to that.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.OptionalDialogue.Kuldra.3: Now she turns the dragonkin's technology on the rest of the world, seemingly fueled by a mindless hatred for the rest of us.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.OptionalDialogue.Kuldra.4: She's turned their machine into some sort of weapon, building wave after wave of discordant anima and using the veil over this island like some sort of resonating chamber.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.OptionalDialogue.Kuldra.5: Each shockwave gets larger and more destructive by the hour and she threatens the mainland with destruction on a scale not seen since the end of the God Wars.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.OptionalDialogue.Kuldra.6: We must stop her, at all costs.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.OptionalDialogue.Dragonki: The dragonkin are older than the world. Indeed they are older than the universe, coming, as they do, from the iteration before.
Yes, an iteration, there have been others. Countless others, stretching back across timelines so vast the entire history of Gielinor wouldn't even register as a dot.
And what have the dragonkin done with that time? With that impossible history? They create monsters.

That tells you everything you need to know about them. With all the time in creation, and all the secrets they have uncovered in that time, they create armies of dragons to torture the rest of us with.

The five who ventured to Ashenfall are no different. Whilst they labelled themselves as mavericks and visionaries, they simply repeat the mistakes of their kin, and add an extra layer or two of horror.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.OptionalDialogue.Exit.1: Very well. I will be here when you're ready to face Kuldra.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.Female.Intro.6: But if you think you're prepared enough, are you read to kill a queen?
KeysToEntries.Elder.ReturnStaff.1: You carry the Staff of Lougrim, our foremother! Bless the stars!
KeysToEntries.Elder.ReturnStaff.2: My natural instinct is to tell you to bring it to Uzzer or Manafem, that they have better claim to it, but things have changed in the Sands.
KeysToEntries.Elder.ReturnStaff.3: They look to us now. Alcarrid leads. And we shall lead with the Staff of Lougrim.
KeysToEntries.Elder.ReturnStaff.4: Please, I offer this in return. Perhaps Lougrim will guide you as much as she guided us.
KeysToEntries.Elder.Return.NoStaff.1: Welcome back, friend of the Moon Garou. I hope the magic carpet is serving you well.
KeysToEntries.Elder.Return.NoStaff.2: Be careful if you happen to use it with the Leggings of Lightness. I can't guarantee your safety.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.PostKuldraDeath.1: There is a stillness in the Underworld. A quietude. You have achieved something remarkable.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.PostKuldraDeath.2: You have not just become a legend. You have become THE legend of Ashenfall - the one that all the other stories build towards.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.PostKuldraDeath.3: While I may be immortal, I can be forgotten. In your case, there is no chance of being forgotten at all. Your legacy is cast in iron.
KeysToEntries.Zilyana.GothereTooEarly: Hrmm, here a bit soon arne't you? Shouldn't you take out the generals before facing the queen?
KeysToEntries.PlayerNarration.Genderless.GoThroughDoor: The door opens with disturbing ease.
KeysToEntries.Objective.ScornedWilderness: Gain access to the Scorned Wilderness.
KeysToEntries.Objective.WhenReady: Once you are fully prepared, speak to Zilyana.
KeysToEntries.PlayerNotification.GenderlessVoice.NoSpa: Your inventory is too full. You cannot collect Kuldra's head.
KeysToEntries.PlayerNotification.GenderlessVoice.Retur: Pause your run and return to Zilyana?
KeysToEntries.Quest.Description: Take the fight to Kuldra, and end this once and for all.
